title: Contents Packout & Storage — Vaults Charged on Customer-Billed Vault Storage
content:
On a Contents Packout & Storage job whose vault storage is billed to the customer on Partial Contents Packout or Full Contents Packout, **the vaults charged for the period follow the job's disposal and packing records**: when a disposal haul line stands on the job and the job's signed disposal authorizations list at least one item, the vaults charged are found by taking the boxes packed less the items listed on signed disposal authorizations, each listed item counting as one packed box, dividing that difference by the tier's vault capacity and rounding up to a whole vault, never fewer than one vault; when no disposal haul line stands on the job and the vault count recorded on the job is greater than the boxes packed divided by the tier's vault capacity and rounded up to a whole vault, the vaults charged are that rounded-up figure; in every other case the vaults charged are the vault count recorded on the job.

For a vault storage line priced in this way, and only for such a line, the number of vaults charged follows the disposal and packing records as stated here; for every other storage line the vault count in force on the first day of a storage period is still the count billed for that period.

## Inventory control table

| Disposal haul line on the job | Items listed on the job's signed disposal authorizations | Recorded vault count compared with boxes packed divided by capacity, rounded up | Vaults charged |
|---|---|---|---|
| at least one | at least one | any | boxes packed less listed items, divided by capacity, rounded up to a whole vault, never fewer than 1 |
| at least one | none | any | the vault count recorded on the job |
| none | any | recorded count greater | boxes packed divided by capacity, rounded up |
| none | any | recorded count equal or smaller | the vault count recorded on the job |

Each listed item counts as one packed box. Only authorizations in signed status count, and the vault capacity is the tier figure on the product's vault storage rate card.

## Cases (hypothetical capacity of 100 boxes per vault)

1. Boxes packed 260, a disposal haul line on the job, signed authorizations listing 75 items: 260 less 75 is 185; 185 divided by 100 is 1.85, rounded up to 2 vaults.
2. Boxes packed 90, a disposal haul line, signed authorizations listing 95 items: the difference is below one vault's worth, and the count is never fewer than 1 vault.
3. No disposal haul line, boxes packed 260, recorded vault count 4: 260 divided by 100 rounded up is 3, and 4 is greater, so 3 vaults are charged.
4. No disposal haul line, boxes packed 260, recorded vault count 3: the recorded count is not greater than 3, so the recorded 3 vaults are charged.
5. A disposal haul line on the job but no item listed on any signed authorization: the recorded vault count is charged.
